title: UNF.PI.------TH.CONT.DY
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 452 (TRF(CW)-24). UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) is the subject; TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RE-ST (restructuralism), WO-UNI and C-INFO (composite information). From RE-ST: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From EXT-FT: SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From WO-UNI: ECO-DY (economic dynamics). From ECO-DY: POL-P (political policies). From C-INFO: PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From MT-INTR: MT-INFO-DB.
